text_block_list.text:
One day, Sakura Bakushin O's homeroom 
teacher came to consult me about her 
grades.

"She's diligent, but her test scores 
aren't looking good. She wants to do 
something about it, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-hum♪ In spring, the dawn~♪ In 
summer, the night~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Well, well, if it isn't Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Was that from "The Pillow Book" just now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You figured it out! We actually just 
learned about that in class today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The passage describing the beauty of the 
four seasons left a very deep impression 
on me as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The shock was so immense that everything 
else completely flew right out of my head!

If she forgets things the moment she 
learns them, scoring well on tests is 
bound to be difficult. To help improve the 
situation even a little—
choice_data_list: Praise them to encourage them to study

text_block_list.text:
If I encourage her through praise while 
she studies, her motivation and focus 
might improve, and with it, her grades...
choice_data_list: You've really been studying hard, huh!

You've really been studying hard, haven't 
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"As the Class Representative, I must apply 
myself diligently to class to serve as a 
role model for everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mufuu! You're more than welcome to praise 
me even more, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The more I'm praised, the more I thrive, 
after all!
choice_data_list:
Keep that up and study hard for the tests 
too!

Keep that up and study hard for the tests 
too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, studying for tests!! What an 
honor-student thing to say!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is hot, right?! I'd 
expect nothing less from you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm off right away! Bakushin, 
bakushiiin into the test!!

Sakura Bakushin O struts off triumphantly, 
her face brimming with confidence.
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please listen!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My score went up by a whole two points on 
this test!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"From 2 points to 4 points!! That's 
double! Double the points!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Man! Studying for tests really is 
important after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I shall Bakushin down the path of an 
honor student!!

It might only be a small step, but there 
was no doubt the score had gone up.

I rejoiced together with Sakura Bakushin O 
over her improved grades.

"If we continue to set aside time to 
discuss our classes like this, it should 
serve as a good review."

To help her retain what she learned, I'll 
bring up a topic that piques her interest—
choice_data_list:
How would Bakushin O describe the four 
seasons?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's an interesting question!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Were it I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Spring is all about Bakushin! Running 
along the tree-lined path amidst the 
falling cherry blossoms!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Summer means BAKUSHIN! Running under the 
blazing sun is simply splendid as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Autumn means Bakushin! Let's go for a run 
in the mountains while enjoying the autumn 
leaves!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Winter means Bakushin! We shall sprint 
through the snow with more vigor than any 
dog!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...And that's about the gist of it! What 
do you think!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What did you say?!
choice_data_list: I-I think it's very Bakushin O-like!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Right, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The day I am hailed as the Sei Shonagon of 
Tracen Academy might not be so far off 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She's become so famous that every race is 
bound to be clamoring for her—

So I thought, but her interest in "The 
Pillow Book" doesn't seem to have faded in 
the slightest.

"If I can just steer the conversation 
toward topics likely to be on the test—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just imagining that scene makes me 
want to run so badly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's start training early today! In fact, 
let's start right now!!

No sooner had she said it than Sakura 
Bakushin O dashed away at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uwoooooh~~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Spring! Summer! Autumn! Winter! Always 
BAKUSHIN!!!

Her attitude of giving everything her all 
is wonderful. However, her lack of 
endurance and restlessness are a bit of an 
issue.

I decided to tell her homeroom teacher 
that managing these factors effectively 
was vital for improving her academic 
performance.
